violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. The establishment has a CFM, but that employee is off today. The PIC present is working on getting certified.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Provide a CFM as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Hot water temperature at the handwashing sink was 76º. The water heater was not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Provide hot water of at lease 100º at all the handsinks as soon as possible or within 10 days.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 180F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 180F. Due to the water heater not working, the dish machine was not operating properly and the final sanitizing rinse was only 87º.
violations.corrective_action: Correct the water heater issue and ensure the warewashing machine final sanitizing rinse is at least 160ºF. Correct as soon as possible or within 10 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: olives are cooked, placed back in the manufacturer jar, and held at room temperature. The olives were 73ºF during today’s visit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Cooked vegetables, including olives, must be stored cold at 41º and below. The EHS explained this to the PIC who said he would refrigerate the olives from now on. If you want to served the olives at room temperature, they can be removed from refrigeration and held at room temperature for up to four hours, but any leftovers need to be discarded, so it is recommended that only what is needed is taken out. The olives were discarded due to temperature abuse.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the water heater was not working.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Correct the water heater issue as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Due to the water heater not working, the hot water at the three compartment sink was below 110º at 76º
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. Correct the issues with the water and provide hot water of at least 110º at the three compartment sink. Correct as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater was not working and not providing hot water to the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Correct the issues with the water heater as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder voluntarily closed due to an imminent health hazard (sewage back-up at the three compartment sink floor drain).
violations.corrective_action: Correct as soon as possible. Do not reopen until the issue is corrected and approval has been given by the health department.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager present during today’s inspection. It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Provide a CFM at the follow-up.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Report to Health Department, Jaundice
violations.observation: The person in charge did not notify the regulatory authority that a food employee is jaundiced. The employee was not aware of the establishment’s employee health policy.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall notify the regulatory authority when a food employee is jaundiced. The EHS trained the employee on the health policy and she signed an employee reporting agreement.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the three compartment sink with a concentration of 0 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. The dispenser is not working/dispensing properly. Please have the unit serviced so that it is working properly. The manager will hand mix the three compartment sink sanitizing solution. CDI.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: The floor drain for the three compartment sink was clogged and not draining.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. The establishment voluntarily closed. Repair the clog as soon as possible.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS provided EH policy.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided vomit and diarrhea clean up policy.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM will sanitize in 3-vat sink until machine has proper concentration.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The dish machine has a chlorine concentration of less than 50 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain a chlorine concentration of 50-200ppm. Do not use the machine for sanitizing glassware until it is fixed. Please send me a repair invoice for the dish machine within 10 days.
